notes.title: Paper Dolls VR Has Added A New Movement Method And New Features Update
notes.notes:
Hi,I wish all of you guys Merry Christmas in advance. 
After lots of efforts of our dev team,Paper Dolls VR has achieved many great milestones,such as the digital version of PSVR released,and the physical version released in Europe etc., which proved the excellence of Paper Dolls VR.
Now We have added multiple languages option,chapter selection, and smooth movement method that everyone expects. Of course,there will be even bigger surprises waiting for you in the futureːsteamhappyː
Thanks  for your supportːsteammockingː
